messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty SEV2 — multiple BGP session flaps observed in Azure southeastasia (southeastasia) affecting vWAN VPN + ExpressRoute adjacencies. Auto-page sent to oncall network. https://status.azure.com/alert/xxx :rotating_light:

sara_ops: picking this up — saw alerts for high 5xx on private endpoints in sg1 and inference timeouts from onprem customers.

mike_net: I’m on it, grabbing BGP session logs and asking for onprem side to confirm. tagging @leo_sre for potential failover.

maria_support: Customer reports: FinTechCo (Dedicated) and EdutechX (Private) seeing 30-70% request failures, spikes in latency. Support notified both.

mike_net: quick grep from firewall logs shows frequent BGP NOTIF/UPDATE resets from peer AS 65099 at 08:12 UTC.
```
# show bgp peer summary
Neighbor        V    AS MsgRcvd MsgSent  TblVer  InQ OutQ  Up/Down  State/PfxRcd
10.12.0.1       4 65099   12345   12380       0    0    0 00:03:14  Active
```

mike_net: also seeing DNS multipath; queries resolving to a mix of private endpoints that route over the flapping path. suspect path selection oscillation.

raj_backend: confirming application-level retries are spiking; we see KV cache misses and increased token generation retries. Rolling alpha-rate limiting for affected routes to reduce load.

leo_sre: handoff — I’ll take lead for mitigations, @mike_net continue network deep-dive. I’m enabling canary routing to secondary region now.

leo_sre: mitigation action 1: divert traffic for private subnets via tiebreak policy -> prefer `gcp-asia-northeast1` interconnect for affected prefixes. applying route policy to edge routers.

mike_net: pushed temporary outbound BGP community to prefer alternative path:
```
az network vwan hub connection update --name hub-conn-sg1 --set bgpCommunities=["65500:10"]
```

maria_support: notifying customers about temporary routing change and possible 5-10s connection resets. prepping status update.

incident-bot: Release pipeline notifier — route policy change deployed to 3 edge hubs (deploy-id: rpd-2026-03-15-87). No rollback triggered.

mike_net: confirming BGP session stability improved at 08:22 UTC, best path changed to AS 65500 (our alt). BGP flaps dropped from 12/min to <1/min.

leo_sre: running DNS cache flush on regional resolvers to eliminate stale records. commands below:
```
sudo systemctl restart unbound
sudo rndc flush
```

maria_support: customers acked — FinTechCo reporting throughput recovered to 95% of baseline, EdutechX still has intermittent spikes but better.

raj_backend: to reduce risk we added short client-side jitter and extended inference timeout to 45s for private routes. pushing config now.

leo_sre: post-mitigation checks: token error rate down 4x, 95th latency back within SLO for most routes. still monitoring.

mike_net: digging into Azure telemetry — appears a control-plane software upgrade in southeastasia triggered route flap on some hardware. Azure ticket opened: 2109876. Suggested we keep alternative routing until they confirm full control-plane convergence.

maria_support: drafting customer-facing status page. Will mention impacted customers, mitigation steps (temporary routing via GCP interconnect), ETA pending Azure confirmation.

leo_sre: next actions:
- keep alt route live until Azure confirms fix (monitoring window 2h)
- collect pcap and BGP logs for postmortem
- schedule oncall follow-up in 1h to review metrics and rollback plan

mike_net: uploading bgp logs + traceroutes to incident bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/2498765432/bgp-logs.tar.gz

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by leo_sre. Escalation paused.

maria_support: update posted to customers at 08:35 UTC — link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2498765432 (drafted).

leo_sre: marking this thread as active incident, will create formal postmortem after stabilization. tagging @raj_backend for evaluation of retry/backoff changes.

mike_net: FYI we also saw minor vWAN control-plane CPU spikes correlating with the time windows — will include telemetry in ticket.

raj_backend: adding test prompts to eval set to monitor potential quality regressions caused by routing change.

maria_support: closing loop with customers who confirmed recovery. will keep incident open for monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
